name: Letters Menu Hover
description: Large typographic menu where hovering a word flips its letters in a staggered 3D roll and reveals a rotating image card that follows the cursor, with a numbered counter and a custom dot cursor.
contents: Menu of big uppercase words, each with a hidden reveal image
Optional numbered counter before each item
Optional body text block below the menu
behavior: Words slide in with a stagger on load
Hovering a word after a short delay rolls its letters out and in with a staggered 3D flip
An image card scales in and follows the pointer with eased position and rotation based on mouse speed and direction
Image card drops away on leave
Custom cursor grows and fades over menu items and is hidden on coarse pointers
Intro animation is skipped when reduced motion is preferred
Layout wraps on small screens and scales type up from 53em
editableByProps: Background, text, counter, body text and cursor colors
Font sizes, letter padding, fonts and font URLs
Reveal card size, hover delay, rotation and easing amounts
Counter, cursor, bottom fade and body text toggles

needsCodeEdit.where: the anchor element with data-cursor-target inside items.map

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the letter flip direction or easing

fixed: Root fills the viewport height (h-screen) and clips overflow. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Window mousemove listeners are added and removed on unmount
Hover reveal depends on mouse events, touch devices get the tap-triggered hover emulation only
